name: Paint My House
author: Ananta Acharya
description: Paint your xLights layout live from a canvas. Owner mode with text and pictures; visitor mode on phones, gated by a rotating QR code or PIN, with timed turns and a queue.

privacy.summary: Runs a small web page on your network (port 8099) so visitors at your house can paint the lights with a code. Sends nothing to the internet.

collects.what: Visitor IP address and the name they type, shown in the owner's activity list
collects.where: plugin log (logs/fpp-paint-my-house.log); the in-memory activity list clears on restart

privacy.other: Owner controls use FPP's own API routes (/api/plugin/fpp-paint-my-house/...), which are protected only as well as FPP's UI is: set an FPP UI password if others share your network. Creating the overlay model adds one entry to Pixel Overlay Models.
